## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: sector breadth ≤4/11 and both Financials and Industrials are negative; Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology in top performers).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +11.42%) ABOVE TREND, EOG (1W: +7.58% | 1M: +11.72%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing short-term strength: LLY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: +11.23%) ABOVE TREND, SYK (1W: +7.91% | 1M: -6.09%) RECOVERY. Consumer Staples steady: COST (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND, WMT (1W: +2.95% | 1M: +5.11%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Materials weakest: FCX (1W: -11.10% | 1M: -16.36%) BELOW TREND, CRH (1W: -11.21% | 1M: -16.58%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -12.20% | 1M: -8.49%) BELOW TREND. Industrials under pressure: BA (1W: -9.23% | 1M: -4.47%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -5.70% | 1M: +7.73%) CORRECTION. Utilities mixed but slipping: VST (1W: -8.28% | 1M: -15.60%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -11.08% | 1M: -9.21%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: CSCO (1W: +16.21% | 1M: +31.55%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +2.12%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +41.62%) ABOVE TREND, F (1W: +8.92% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: DD (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -0.54%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -7.64% | 1M: +50.59%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -8.13% | 1M: +68.65%) CORRECTION, VST (1W: -8.28% | 1M: -15.60%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -9.23% | 1M: -4.47%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in Materials and select Tech/Utilities names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: CSCO (1W: +16.21% | 1M: +31.55%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +2.12%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +41.62%) ABOVE TREND, F (1W: +8.92% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND. MAJOR divergence present among large caps (MSFT, NVDA, AMZN etc.), so treat momentum as tactical rather than broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed with leaders and breadth divergence: CSCO (1W: +16.21% | 1M: +31.55%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +2.12%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +41.62%) ABOVE TREND, while NVDA (1W: -0.08% | 1M: +9.18%) CORRECTION, AMD (1W: -7.64% | 1M: +50.59%) CORRECTION and INTC (1W: -8.13% | 1M: +68.65%) CORRECTION show short-term fatigue. Technology is mixed and contributing to leadership concentration.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials soft: JPM (1W: -3.01% | 1M: -6.72%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -0.02% | 1M: -3.28%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: +1.07% | 1M: +5.30%) ABOVE TREND — sector-level weakness persists and confirms the RISK-OFF backdrop.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare showing relative defensive footing but mixed momentum: LLY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: +11.23%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +2.56% | 1M: -0.30%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +20.33%) CORRECTION — sector supportive for defensive positioning but watch event risk.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
In a RISK-OFF environment, favor lower-beta defensives and select energy names showing strength (XOM (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND, COST (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: +11.23%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to cyclicals and event-exposed large caps (BA (1W: -9.23% | 1M: -4.47%) BELOW TREND, DD (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -0.54%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; be selective until divergences resolve.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: D (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +9.50%) ABOVE TREND on +90 merger news, CSCO (1W: +16.21% | 1M: +31.55%) ABOVE TREND after upgrade, XOM (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND for energy momentum. BEARISH: BA (1W: -9.23% | 1M: -4.47%) BELOW TREND on mixed safety headlines, UNH (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +20.33%) CORRECTION on insider-trade headlines, META (1W: -0.06% | 1M: -10.18%) BELOW TREND on job-cut headlines.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy and Consumer Staples on recent strength and positive earnings/operational news; Healthcare to monitor for defensive flows. BEARISH: Materials, Industrials and Financials remain at risk; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: -0.08% | 1M: +9.18%) CORRECTION — failure to regain the 1M advance would signal deeper pullback. AAPL (1W: +1.41% | 1M: +9.59%) ABOVE TREND — a loss of the 1W momentum would warn of broader tech softening. XOM (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND — sustained weekly gains confirm energy leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
D (+90): NextEra/Dominion merger headline; D (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +9.50%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. CSCO (+55): HSBC target lift; CSCO (1W: +16.21% | 1M: +31.55%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by strong momentum. VST (+60): analyst upgrades; VST (1W: -8.28% | 1M: -15.60%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines diverge from price, monitor for distribution.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
BA (-80): maintenance lapses headline; BA (1W: -9.23% | 1M: -4.47%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and elevates event risk. UNH (-65): insider-trade headline; UNH (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +20.33%) CORRECTION — bearish sentiment diverges from strong 1M, watch for follow-through. META (-50): job cuts headline; META (1W: -0.06% | 1M: -10.18%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and adds downside pressure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology). XOM (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND, CSCO (1W: +16.21% | 1M: +31.55%) ABOVE TREND and COST (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Major divergence among large caps — MSFT (1W: +2.37% | 1M: -0.16%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: -0.08% | 1M: +9.18%) CORRECTION, AMZN (1W: -2.44% | 1M: +4.45%) CORRECTION — monitor for trend breaks and event-driven sentiment risk (UNH, META).
